
GET-SCENARIOS
Extract scenarios from feature files with optional filtering

USAGE
  fspec get-scenarios [options]

OPTIONS
  --file <file>
    Specific feature file
  --tag <tag>
    Filter by tag (can use multiple)
  --format <format>
    Output format: text, json, or list

EXAMPLES
  1. Get scenarios from file
  $ fspec get-scenarios --file spec/features/login.feature
  Login with valid credentials
Login with invalid password
Login with locked account

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec show-acceptance-criteria
  fspec list-features
